name: Detección Ghostbuster
description: Aplica el método Ghostbuster combinando múltiples señales débiles — búsqueda estructurada sobre combinaciones de características para detección robusta de texto IA.
mechanism:
The Ghostbuster Detection method implements the technique from Verma et al. (2023) for detecting generado por IA text using structured search over weaker language models:

1. **Feature Vector Construction**: The input text is processed through a series of weaker, unstructured language models (e.g., unigram, bigram, trigram models and a small GPT-like model). For each token, the probability assigned by each model is computed, yielding per-token probability vectors from multiple model perspectives.

2. **Document - Level Feature Aggregation**: Token-level probabilities are aggregated into document-level features using selected functions: mean, variance, and quantile statistics of log-probabilities from each model. This creates a compact feature vector capturing the distributional characteristics of the text through multiple linguistic lenses.

3. **Structured Search over Feature Combinations**: A structured search selects the most discriminative combination of features and models. Rather than relying on a single powerful model, Ghostbuster combines signals from multiple weaker models — exploiting the observation that generado por IA text exhibits characteristic probability patterns across different model architectures.

4. **Linear Clasificación**: The selected feature vector is fed into a trained logistic regression classifier. The linear model ensures interpretability and robustness — avoiding overfitting to specific generator architectures. The decision boundary separates human-written text (which shows variable probability across models) from generado por IA text (which tends to be uniformly probable across models).

5. **Confidence Puntuación**: The classifier output probability provides a confidence score. Texts near the decision boundary are flagged as uncertain, while those with strong signals from multiple feature dimensions receive high-confidence predictions. El método generalizes across different generadores de IA without requiring per-model training.
parameters: Tipo de análisis: estadístico automático\nRango de puntuación: 0 (auténtico) a 100 (generado por IA)
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-85% de precisión según la calidad de entrada.
source: Basado en investigación revisada por pares en forense digital y detección de contenido IA.
useCase: Se utiliza como parte del pipeline de análisis multiseñal para detectar contenido generado por IA.
strengths: • Metodología respaldada por investigación\n• Tiempo de cálculo rápido\n• Complementario a otros métodos de detección
limitations: • La precisión varía con la calidad de entrada\n• Mejor utilizado en combinación con otros métodos
